d: Shalimar becomes close to another feral when it's "lust at first sight," but matters become complicated when her new boyfriend tries to find a cure for his condition.
A New Mutant is kidnapped from his family, and Mutant X sets out to recover him and find out what Eckhart's interest in him is.
When a plague that only affects mutants is raging, Adam and Eckhart agree to work together to find a cure.
Eckhart seeks a mutant who can absorb energy, one who Brennan becomes romantically involved with.
Doc treats George's injury and explains the Founding Fathers, the Bill of Rights and more.
The group arrives at the farming outpost that produces flour for Z-bizkuits, but danger awaits.
The group is reunited with old Native friends who are defending a dam that controls Newmerica's water.
The group discovers Altura militia forces have enslaved talkers to mine hazardous waste for Z-bizkuits.
With help from renegade hackers, Warren and George hack Altura's defenses and discover Estes' secret plan.
Estes imprisons the captive talkers and blends, while Warren and George plan their attack on Altura.

t: Z Nation: The End of Everything
d: Warren works with humans, talkers and blends to help George defeat Estes and Pandora.
A team starts its journey transporting the only survivor of the zombie virus from New York to Los Angeles, CA.
The team struggles to gas up in a dangerous oil refinery packed with zombies.
The team comes to Addy's rescue after a 'family' of cannibals kidnaps her.

st: In the Presence of Mine Enemies
d: Jesse falls in love with a computer hacker, who Eckhart wants to "procure" in order to corrupt the public computer news channels against New Mutants...and to the GSA's benefit.
A boy who's developing new mutant abilities has been kidnapped and the team agrees to find him for his mother. They later learn she was the one who had her son kidnapped.
The team encounters some people trying to break into a Genomex lab and discover that they're ferals.
A New Mutant with the power of invisibility is working against both Eckhart and Adam, despite the fact she was involved with Adam in the past.
An old friend of Brennan's lures him and Emma into a trap. Emma ends up split into two separate entities, one good and one evil.
Jesse is roped into a deadly undercover mission by his estranged father, who is working against Eckhart.
